## Combo 1753-3259-7917--185
Cards: Breath of Fury + Seluma, Light of Aysen + Samut, Voice of Dissent
Color identity: RGW | Bracket: Banned | Popularity: 0 | Commander: not legal
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite combat damage; Infinite combat phases; Infinite death triggers; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite untap of creatures you control
Requires: 2x Angel Creature (battlefield, graveyard)
Start: Breath of Fury (battlefield: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield); Seluma, Light of Aysen (battlefield); Samut, Voice of Dissent (battlefield)
Prerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
  Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Repeat each combat phase.
Notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Samut can be omitted.

Produces: Infinite charge counters on a permanent; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite self-mill; Infinitely large creature until end of turn; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Spawning Pit (battlefield); Lithatog (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
Steps: Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
  Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
  When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
